WITH temp_view_0 AS (
SELECT /*+ materialize */ F0_0."AGGR_0" AS "AGGR_0", F0_0."AGGR_1" AS "AGGR_1", F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__orderkey AS prov_lineitem_l__orderkey, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__partkey AS prov_lineitem_l__partkey, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__suppkey AS prov_lineitem_l__suppkey, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__linenumber AS prov_lineitem_l__linenumber, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__quantity AS prov_lineitem_l__quantity, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__extendedprice AS prov_lineitem_l__extendedprice, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__discount AS prov_lineitem_l__discount, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__tax AS prov_lineitem_l__tax, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__returnflag AS prov_lineitem_l__returnflag, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__linestatus AS prov_lineitem_l__linestatus, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__shipdate AS prov_lineitem_l__shipdate, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__commitdate AS prov_lineitem_l__commitdate, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__receiptdate AS prov_lineitem_l__receiptdate, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__shipinstruct AS prov_lineitem_l__shipinstruct, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__shipmode AS prov_lineitem_l__shipmode, F1_0.prov_lineitem_l__comment AS prov_lineitem_l__comment, F1_0.prov_part_p__partkey AS prov_part_p__partkey, F1_0.prov_part_p__name AS prov_part_p__name, F1_0.prov_part_p__mfgr AS prov_part_p__mfgr, F1_0.prov_part_p__brand AS prov_part_p__brand, F1_0.prov_part_p__type AS prov_part_p__type, F1_0.prov_part_p__size AS prov_part_p__size, F1_0.prov_part_p__container AS prov_part_p__container, F1_0.prov_part_p__retailprice AS prov_part_p__retailprice, F1_0.prov_part_p__comment AS prov_part_p__comment
FROM ((
SELECT sum((CASE  WHEN (F1_0.p_type LIKE 'PROMO%') THEN (F0_0.l_extendedprice * (1 - F0_0.l_discount)) ELSE 0 END)) AS "AGGR_0", sum((F0_0.l_extendedprice * (1 - F0_0.l_discount))) AS "AGGR_1"
FROM (lineitem F0_0 CROSS JOIN part F1_0)
WHERE (((F0_0.l_partkey = F1_0.p_partkey) AND (F0_0.l_shipdate >= ('1995-09-01')::date)) AND (F0_0.l_shipdate < ('1995-10-01')::date))) F0_0 LEFT OUTER JOIN (
SELECT (CASE  WHEN (F0_0.p_type LIKE 'PROMO%') THEN (F0_0.l_extendedprice * (1 - F0_0.l_discount)) ELSE 0 END) AS "AGG_GB_ARG0", (F0_0.l_extendedprice * (1 - F0_0.l_discount)) AS "AGG_GB_ARG1", F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__orderkey AS prov_lineitem_l__orderkey, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__partkey AS prov_lineitem_l__partkey, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__suppkey AS prov_lineitem_l__suppkey, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__linenumber AS prov_lineitem_l__linenumber, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__quantity AS prov_lineitem_l__quantity, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__extendedprice AS prov_lineitem_l__extendedprice, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__discount AS prov_lineitem_l__discount, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__tax AS prov_lineitem_l__tax, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__returnflag AS prov_lineitem_l__returnflag, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__linestatus AS prov_lineitem_l__linestatus, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__shipdate AS prov_lineitem_l__shipdate, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__commitdate AS prov_lineitem_l__commitdate, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__receiptdate AS prov_lineitem_l__receiptdate, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__shipinstruct AS prov_lineitem_l__shipinstruct, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__shipmode AS prov_lineitem_l__shipmode, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__comment AS prov_lineitem_l__comment, F0_0.prov_part_p__partkey AS prov_part_p__partkey, F0_0.prov_part_p__name AS prov_part_p__name, F0_0.prov_part_p__mfgr AS prov_part_p__mfgr, F0_0.prov_part_p__brand AS prov_part_p__brand, F0_0.prov_part_p__type AS prov_part_p__type, F0_0.prov_part_p__size AS prov_part_p__size, F0_0.prov_part_p__container AS prov_part_p__container, F0_0.prov_part_p__retailprice AS prov_part_p__retailprice, F0_0.prov_part_p__comment AS prov_part_p__comment
FROM (
SELECT F0_0.l_orderkey AS l_orderkey, F0_0.l_partkey AS l_partkey, F0_0.l_suppkey AS l_suppkey, F0_0.l_linenumber AS l_linenumber, F0_0.l_quantity AS l_quantity, F0_0.l_extendedprice AS F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__discount AS prov_lineitem_l__discount, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__tax AS prov_lineitem_l__tax, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__returnflag AS prov_lineitem_l__returnflag, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__linestatus AS prov_lineitem_l__linestatus, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__shipdate AS prov_lineitem_l__shipdate, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__commitdate AS prov_lineitem_l__commitdate, F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__comment AS prov_lineitem_l__comment, F1_0.prov_part_p__partkey AS prov_part_p__partkey, F1_0.prov_part_p__name AS prov_part_p__name, F1_0.prov_part_p__mfgr AS prov_part_p__mfgr, F1_0.prov_part_p__brand AS prov_part_p__brand, F1_0.prov_part_p__type AS prov_part_p__type, F1_0.prov_part_p__size AS prov_part_p__size, F1_0.prov_part_p__container AS prov_part_p__container, F1_0.prov_part_p__retailprice AS prov_part_p__retailprice, F1_0.prov_part_p__comment AS prov_part_p__comment
FROM ((
SELECT F0_0.l_orderkey AS l_orderkey, F0_0.l_partkey AS l_partkey, F0_0.l_suppkey AS l_suppkey, F0_0.l_linenumber AS l_linenumber, F0_0.l_quantity AS l_quantity, F0_0.l_extendedprice AS l_extendedprice, F0_0.l_discount AS l_discount, F0_0.l_tax AS l_tax, F0_0.l_returnflag AS l_returnflag, F0_0.l_linestatus AS l_linestatus, F0_0.l_shipdate AS l_shipdate, F0_0.l_commitdate AS l_commitdate, F0_0.l_receiptdate AS l_receiptdate, F0_0.l_shipinstruct AS l_shipinstruct, F0_0.l_shipmode AS l_shipmode, F0_0.l_comment AS l_comment, F0_0.l_orderkey AS prov_lineitem_l__orderkey, F0_0.l_partkey AS prov_lineitem_l__partkey, F0_0.l_suppkey AS prov_lineitem_l__suppkey, F0_0.l_linenumber AS prov_lineitem_l__linenumber, F0_0.l_quantity AS prov_lineitem_l__quantity, F0_0.l_extendedprice AS prov_lineitem_l__extendedprice, F0_0.l_discount AS prov_lineitem_l__discount, F0_0.l_tax AS prov_lineitem_l__tax, F0_0.l_returnflag AS prov_lineitem_l__returnflag, F0_0.l_linestatus AS prov_lineitem_l__linestatus, F0_0.l_shipdate AS prov_lineitem_l__shipdate, F0_0.l_commitdate AS prov_lineitem_l__commitdate, F0_0.l_receiptdate AS prov_lineitem_l__receiptdate, F0_0.l_shipinstruct AS prov_lineitem_l__shipinstruct, F0_0.l_shipmode AS prov_lineitem_l__shipmode, F0_0.l_comment AS prov_lineitem_l__comment
FROM lineitem F0_0) F0_0 CROSS JOIN (
SELECT F0_0.p_partkey AS p_partkey, F0_0.p_name AS p_name, F0_0.p_mfgr AS p_mfgr, F0_0.p_brand AS p_brand, F0_0.p_type AS p_type, F0_0.p_size AS p_size, F0_0.p_container AS p_container, F0_0.p_retailprice AS p_retailprice, F0_0.p_comment AS p_comment, F0_0.p_partkey AS prov_part_p__partkey, F0_0.p_name AS prov_part_p__name, F0_0.p_mfgr AS prov_part_p__mfgr, F0_0.p_brand AS prov_part_p__brand, F0_0.p_type AS prov_part_p__type, F0_0.p_size AS prov_part_p__size, F0_0.p_container AS prov_part_p__container, F0_0.p_retailprice AS prov_part_p__retailprice, F0_0.p_comment AS prov_part_p__comment
FROM part F0_0) F1_0)) F0_0
WHERE (((F0_0.l_partkey = F0_0.p_partkey) AND (F0_0.l_shipdate >= ('1995-09-01')::date)) AND (F0_0.l_shipdate < ('1995-10-01')::date))) F1_0 ON ((1 = 1))))
SELECT ((100.000000 * F0_0."AGGR_0") / F0_0."AGGR_1") AS promo_revenue
FROM (SELECT * FROM temp_view_0) F0_0
GROUP BY ((100.000000 * F0_0."AGGR_0") / F0_0."AGGR_1")
HAVING (avg(F0_0.prov_lineitem_l__quantity) >= 30);
